grammar.title: Verb-object compound words
grammar.pattern: verb + built-in object (吃饭, 上班, 见面, 起床, 唱歌...)
grammar.explanation: Many common actions are written as a fixed verb + object pair that work together like a single verb: 吃饭 ("to eat/have a meal"), 上班 ("to go to work"), 见面 ("to meet"), 起床 ("to get up"), 唱歌 ("to sing"). Treat the whole pair as one unit — don't insert another object after it the way you would with an ordinary verb.

sentences.en: What time do you get up?
